model.name: SprintPinResolver.deriveSprintStatus
model.description: deriveSprintStatus(sprint) rolls sprint.tasks[] up via R-C5 deriveStatusEnum (single-source: sprint<->tasks cannot disagree, INV-C1-2). TERMINAL-RESOLVED(task) = (deriveStatusEnum==Done) OR task.supersededBy present. CLOSED = tasks non-empty AND every task terminal-resolved (display keeps Done vs Superseded counts DISTINCT — never collapse to Done, INV-C1-7); Active = >=1 In-Progress not-superseded; QA-pending; Planned. Reuses R-C5 with NO extension — supersededBy is a SEPARATE field (PO ruling B), not a status enum value, so the consistency sprint never contradicts itself. R-C1.
